mostWorthwhile.text: Supplying oxygen to the mitochondrion was the strongest payoff: the planned diagram connects electron transfer, the hydrogen-ion gradient and ATP synthase.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the pump was a necessary but relatively uneventful intermediate step; its purpose became clearer once ATP powered transport.

surprise.text: The final protein-making picture explicitly separates pyruvate from the protein chain while showing tRNA matching an mRNA triplet.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though choosing between the two ATP supplies was not explained as a meaningful difference; I chose cytosolic ATP partly because I had already used mitochondrial ATP.

continue.text: I would continue: linking ATP production to transport and protein-making made the constructions worthwhile, though I would want similarly clear explanations of abbreviated mechanisms.
